text_to_image_prompt: Generate one original cinematic environment photograph, landscape 3:2, full bleed, no collage, no borders, no captions. A richly observed film set with a specific emotional story, original architecture and arrangement, not a replica of a film frame. Vicky aesthetic: luminous high-key exposure with retained highlight detail, cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown, restrained pastel accents, broad soft daylight, filled low shadows, fine natural material texture and wear, very subtle film halation and grain, elegant believable photographic realism. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective, layered foreground/midground/background, gentle depth separation but environment clearly readable. Space reserved at central lower midground for future character compositing. ABSOLUTELY EMPTY ENVIRONMENT: no people, no characters, no animals, birds or insects, no human silhouettes, no human reflections, no hands, no faces on paintings, posters or screens, no statues or mannequins. No logos, watermarks, readable text. Avoid CGI real-estate renders, sterile showrooms, excessive bloom, orange grading, deep black shadows, ultrawide distortion. Scene: original 1930s European railway station side concourse before opening, photograph of a real period film set. High milk-glass barrel-vault roof and pale gray iron arches, creamy stone walls, a large simple analog clock centered above a passage at rear (no written lettering), warm brown wooden waiting benches along left wall, a closed wooden ticket kiosk on right, a small tan suitcase beside the nearest bench. A partial foreground arch frames the view. The floor is pale worn limestone, soft daylight pools gently with low shadows, corridor leads toward bright hazy platforms without any train occupants or pedestrians. Keep central floor clear. Research inspiration: Hugo's crafted railway architecture and clock motif; remake as luminous pale cream and warm wood, intimate lower concourse scale, no turquoise-orange night look, no steampunk clutter. Emotion: departure, reunion, a hidden letter.
